# usage relationship scope

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usageRelationshipScope`](gmeow-usageRelationshipScope.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usageRelationshipScope>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The interpersonal relationship that scopes a name-usage (e.g. the aunt-niece tie within which 'Aunt Genny' is used) — reuses the contacts relator. A sharper alternative to [`gmeow:usageAudience`](gmeow-usageAudience.md) when the scope is exactly one standing relationship.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) -> [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:usageRelationshipScope`](gmeow-usageRelationshipScope.md) from [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) to [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md), [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a name-usage's scope is exactly one standing interpersonal relationship — the aunt-niece tie within which 'Aunt Genny' is used — reusing the contacts relator rather than naming a broader audience.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a broad or open audience (use [`gmeow:usageAudience`](gmeow-usageAudience.md) there) and avoid minting a fresh relationship just to scope a usage — reference the existing [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:usageRelationshipScope`](gmeow-usageRelationshipScope.md) to the relevant [`gmeow:InterpersonalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-InterpersonalRelationship.md) once per [`NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) (functional); when the scope is wider than one tie, fall back to [`gmeow:usageAudience`](gmeow-usageAudience.md).

### Examples

- ex:usageFamily [`gmeow:usageRelationshipScope`](gmeow-usageRelationshipScope.md) ex:auntNieceTie.
